First, a new identity locks 240 units in escrow for 15 epochs. A hollow shell cannot pass, and the vault holds the stake untouchable.

Then, a river of challenges may arrive in a 3-epoch window. Nine jurors rule in 2 epochs. A proven fake loses 80%, and 25% rewards the challenger.

Finally, the fake is banned 12 epochs, and clean epochs release 20 units. For 1,000 clones, 240,000 lock up; 30% caught burns 57,600 and 14,400 go to challengers.
